items.title: Santo Pecora Interview, 1972-11-09
items.q: [INTERVIEWER] Did you know Omar Simeo? ... [INTERVIEWEE] I heard of him. No, I heard of him.

ctx.x: Nile Wettland. Yeah. Nile, see? Yeah. Josh Wettland played there.
Did you know Omar Simeo? Clarinet player, a colored clarinet player? He used to work with Jolly Roll?
I heard of him. No, I heard of him. But you don't remember him.
